lead_independence.headline: United Way of Martin County's Ride United Program Strained by Transit Cuts
lead_independence.lead: The United Way of Martin County is asking the community for help as demand for its Ride United transportation program surges following last week's shutdown of the MARTY bus service and earlier state budget cuts to another transit program. Carol Houwaart-Diez, president and CEO of the United Way of Martin County, says the MARTY closure has pushed even more riders toward Ride United, which was already strained.
